Calculator Kid Kid 0.1.0

เครื่องคิดเลข คิดคิด

This calculator works offline. No ads, accounts, Internet permission, analytics, or personal data collection. Memory, settings, and calculation history are stored only on this device. Android backup is disabled. Clipboard access occurs only when you choose Paste or Copy result.

Long press M1/M2 to erase that register immediately. Long press the result to copy. Hardware: Enter =, Ctrl+Z Undo, Ctrl+Shift+Z or Ctrl+Y Redo, Ctrl+V Paste.

Development build: contextual percent edge cases and device acceptance remain unverified. A public privacy-policy URL and signing are required before Play release.
